title: jwt authentication login logout and registration
description: Test the authentication API endpoints for user login, logout, and registration using JWT tokens. Verify token issuance, expiry, and role-based access control enforcement.

title: admin user management crud and role assignment
description: Verify the user management API endpoints accessible only by admin users. Test CRUD operations on users, role assignments, and password update policies including email validation and password security.

title: article management crud and stock tracking
description: Test the article management API for creating, reading, updating, and deleting articles. Verify stock tracking by location and role-based access control enforcement.

title: order creation status management and history tracking
description: Validate the order management API for creating orders with multiple articles, status updates, external order number integration, and order history retrieval.

title: inventory tracking stock movements and location management
description: Test inventory management API endpoints for real-time stock level tracking, stock movement logs, and location-based stock calculations.

title: stock movement purchase orders goods receipt and adjustments
description: Verify stock movement API endpoints for processing purchase orders, goods receipt registration, stock adjustments, and user attribution in logs.

title: barcode generation validation and scanning
description: Test barcode generation API endpoints for producing valid standardized barcodes linked to article SKUs, barcode scanning functionality, and format support.

title: database context and data model integrity
description: Validate the database context and data models for correct entity relationships, data seeding, and consistency with API operations.

title: jwt cors and security policy enforcement
description: Test the configuration and security setup including JWT settings, CORS policies, HTTPS enforcement, input validation, and event logging.

title: api performance and concurrency under load
description: Verify API response times under 2 seconds for standard operations and test support for 100 concurrent users to ensure scalability and reliability.
